evidence.excerpt:
interface:
  display_name: "Spec Implement Loop"
  short_description: "Run a root spec through verified delivery"
policy:
  allow_implicit_invocation: false

For every required skill, resolve and read its original `SKILL.md` from the active skill roots regardless of whether a skill catalog exposes it or its invocation metadata permits automatic invocation.
Do not install dependencies automatically.

required_capabilities.name: Read and resolve declared prerequisite skill sources; follow their invocation and authorization instructions
required_capabilities.unavailable_behavior: If a declared source is missing or unreadable, stop and direct the user to its prerequisite-guide entry; do not install automatically. If a dependency requires direct user invocation, pause at that gate. Availability of the external sources is recorded for prerequisite governance.

evidence.excerpt: Complete every check before doing any work; report all failures together and stop on any failure.
For inline and local-file inputs, the supplied source remains authoritative.
If a root is clearly too large for one implementation round, pause and ask for approval to load and run `/to-tickets`.

required_capabilities.name: Authoritative task input and repository file access (inline, local-file, or GitHub input)
required_capabilities.unavailable_behavior: Complete preflight before work and stop on failures. Preserve the input-specific source of truth; do not substitute another source. If the root is unclear or too large, pause to ask or report instead of creating tickets automatically.

evidence.excerpt: For a confirmed transient failure, choose a retry count based on the error, capped at three total attempts for the same ref and commit including the first; do not retry permanent or unsafe-to-repeat errors.

required_capabilities.name: Local worktree, branch, Git, and task-remote access
required_capabilities.unavailable_behavior: Preflight requires a clean worktree, a non-detached branch, and a resolvable task remote; report failures together and stop. For a confirmed transient push failure, retry within the three-attempt limit; after exhaustion, stop and report the local commit and error. Reconcile uncertain results before retrying.

evidence.excerpt: Classify dependency when a required blocker remains unsatisfied; technical for an implementation or verification failure; external-service for a known service or network failure;
For GitHub inputs, the Issue task contract and native dependency edges are authoritative; use the ready guard above when checking dependency completion.
If retries fail, stop and report that code is pushed but status is unsynchronised; do not roll back the code.

required_capabilities.name: GitHub Issue input, comment/label reads, and status synchronization (conditional on GitHub input)
required_capabilities.unavailable_behavior: Keep GitHub as the authoritative source. Classify known service or network failures as external-service blockers and reconcile uncertain operations before retrying. Status writes have bounded transient retries and report an unsynchronized state after exhaustion. No dedicated retry or alternate-source policy is stated for initial Issue/comment/label reads.

evidence.excerpt: If a required check cannot run because its runner or environment is unavailable, mark it not run, record the exact reason, and enter `blocked` for the affected ticket; never treat it as passing.
